title: I didn't receive my direct deposit
summary: This document provides troubleshooting for a missing direct deposit: check your bank account, confirm with the direct deposit payer, and ask the bank whether the deposit was rejected. It also notes a possible temporary hold of “Yes” if part of the deposit is unavailable, and lists next steps including verifying account/routing numbers and requesting the deposit trace information for resubmission after rejection.
faqs: What should I check first if my direct deposit isn’t showing in my bank account?
How do I confirm whether the direct deposit payer actually sent the payment?
What should I ask the bank to determine if my deposit was rejected?
If only part of my deposit is available, what temporary hold could apply?
If the deposit is missing, what account details do I need to confirm with the payer?
How can I get trace information and what do I do if the bank confirms rejection?
